items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I added Lonnie Simmons to the band when we went to the Roseland.

ctx.x: Lonnie Simmons. I added Lonnie Simmons to the band when we went to the Roseland. Remember when I took over the band? Lonnie was out in Chicago. Lonnie played organ and tenor, but we never used him on organ. He used to play tenor. Because eventually, he went back to Chicago, and he had his combo around Chicago. It was very famous.
